description: Buildings Surveyed after 2017 Mexico City Earthquakes is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Santiago Pujol, Purdue University (purdue.edu). This project consists of building data collected in Mexico City after the 19 September 2017 Puebla-Morelos Earthquake. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-vpce-c875. Keywords: 2017 Mexico City Earthquake, reinforced concrete. Published 2019-09-12. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
